mapper.select: SELECT SRL_NO , ALS , FORM_NO , ALPH , (SELECT CASE WHEN P.GNDR = 'f' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TI.IMAGE_G2, ''), TI.IMAGE) ELSE TI.IMAGE END FROM pokedex_json TI WHERE TI.DEX_NR = P.NO AND TI.DEX_FORM_NR = P.FORM_NO) AS imgSrc , CONCAT(NO, '_', FORM_NO, '_', GNDR) AS imgAlt FROM ${tableName} P ORDER BY SRL_NO DESC

SELECT SRL_NO , ALS , FORM_NO , ALPH , (SELECT CASE WHEN P.GNDR = 'f' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TI.IMAGE_G2, ''), TI.IMAGE) ELSE TI.IMAGE END FROM pokedex_json TI WHERE TI.DEX_NR = P.NO AND TI.DEX_FORM_NR = P.FORM_NO) AS imgSrc , CONCAT(NO, '_', FORM_NO, '_', GNDR) AS imgAlt FROM ${tableName} P WHERE NO IN ( SELECT no FROM pokedex WHERE name LIKE CONCAT(#{vo.srchNm}, '%') ) ORDER BY SRL_NO DESC

SELECT SRL_NO , ALS , FORM_NO , ALPH , (SELECT CASE WHEN P.GNDR = 'f' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TI.IMAGE_G2, ''), TI.IMAGE) ELSE TI.IMAGE END FROM pokedex_json TI WHERE TI.DEX_NR = P.NO AND TI.DEX_FORM_NR = P.FORM_NO) AS imgSrc , CONCAT(NO, '_', FORM_NO, '_', GNDR) AS imgAlt FROM ${tableName} P WHERE NO IN ( SELECT no FROM pokedex WHERE base_no IN ( SELECT base_no FROM pokedex WHERE name LIKE CONCAT(#{vo.srchNm}, '%') ) ) ORDER BY SRL_NO DESC

SELECT SRL_NO , ALS , FORM_NO , ALPH , (SELECT CASE WHEN P.GNDR = 'f' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TI.IMAGE_G2, ''), TI.IMAGE) ELSE TI.IMAGE END FROM pokedex_json TI WHERE TI.DEX_NR = P.NO AND TI.DEX_FORM_NR = P.FORM_NO) AS imgSrc , CONCAT(NO, '_', FORM_NO, '_', GNDR) AS imgAlt FROM ${tableName} P WHERE SUBSTRING(ALS, #{position}, 1) = #{value} ORDER BY SRL_NO DESC
